name: Railcraft High Pressure Boiler (Liquid Fuel) 1x1
notes: Railcraft high-pressure steam boiler, liquid fuel (1x1 firebox, Railcraft 9.17.31, the version in GTNH 2.9.0-beta-3). Liquid-fuelled firebox at the base (16,000 L fuel tank, regardless of size), high-pressure tanks above; no walls (fireboxes and tanks only, per the wiki). It cannot wallshare and must be at least one block from another boiler (minGap 1). One tank layer. Pipes: fluid and item input only at the firebox base; output only into tank blocks. No hatches are modelled.
